facts.item: loss of consciousness: what I was doing
facts.text: It happened while I was pitching in a baseball game.

facts.item: loss of consciousness: injury or blow
facts.text: There wasn't any injury or blow involved.
I was told I came round after I was given CPR.
I didn't have any headaches before I passed out.
I hadn't had any seizures before this happened.
I didn't have any chest pain before I passed out.
I didn't notice any palpitations before I passed out.
I wasn't short of breath before I passed out.
I didn't feel dizzy before I passed out.
I've never had any neurological problems.
I've never had any heart or circulation problems.
I don't have any significant medical problems.
I'm active and play sports regularly.

findings.name: heart examination
findings.result: Palpation: double apical impulse; auscultation: S4 present; no audible murmurs.

findings.name: echocardiogram
findings.result: Left ventricular hypertrophy with septal thickening; reduced ventricular cavity size.

findings.name: cardiac MRI
findings.result: Marked left ventricular hypertrophy, especially of the interventricular septum.

findings.name: genetic testing
findings.result: Positive for mutations associated with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.

quotes.f002: while pitching in a baseball game
quotes.f003: No history of trauma associated with the event
quotes.f004: regained consciousness after receiving cardiopulmonary resuscitation
quotes.f010: or dizziness prior to the event
quotes.f014: Active, with regular participation in sports.

f005: 'prior to the event' closes the ROS list; it is applied to every item, so each denial is limited to the time before the collapse.
f006: For seizures 'prior to the event' reads as no earlier seizures; whether he had convulsive movements during the collapse is unknown.
f004: He was unconscious, so the CPR is worded as what he was told.

x006.source_text: Double apical impulse palpable + Present + No audible murmurs

x008.source_text: Left ventricular hypertrophy with septal thickening; reduced ventricular cavity size

x009.source_text: Confirmatory findings of marked left ventricular hypertrophy, especially of the interventricular septum

x010.source_text: Positive for mutations associated with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy

x009: Source prefix 'Confirmatory findings of' dropped from the result: it is review commentary pointing at an already-made diagnosis.

leakage.reason: The genetic test result names the gold diagnosis (hypertrophic cardiomyopathy); kept because it is what the test reports.

source_issues: Gold diagnosis text appears in Test_Results (genetic testing; pool flag visible_gold_alias_partitions = test_results).
Secondary_Symptoms holds two history denials ('No history of neurological problems', 'No history of cardiovascular problems'), not symptoms; converted to medical_history facts.
The cardiac MRI entry begins with 'Confirmatory findings of', which presupposes the diagnosis.
notes: Collapse while pitching, CPR and no trauma are children of the loss-of-consciousness fact (context, treatment_response). The event is over, so f001 has time 'resolved'.
The JVP is a separate request from the heart examination; apical impulse palpation and auscultation (S4, no murmurs) are combined in one heart examination record.
ECG and echocardiogram results name left ventricular hypertrophy, a finding, not the gold diagnosis; they are not listed as leakage.

extras.objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the patient presenting with sudden loss of consciousness and no prior history of neurological or cardiovascular problems.
